exercicio.statement:
Christian and Miranda both go to Carmite Middle School. They measured the distance between their home and the school to figure out who lives closer to the school. Use the number line to find out.
Christian lives 4/10 of a mile from the school.
Miranda lives 2/5 of a mile from the school.
Who lives closer to school?

steps.instruction: Use the fraction model to represent Christian’s distance, 4/10 of a mile, as a value less than 1.
Set Christian’s number line to the number of equal parts shown by the denominator of 4/10.
On Christian’s number line, mark the point for 4/10 of a mile.
Set Miranda’s number line to the number of equal parts shown by the denominator of 2/5.
On Miranda’s number line, mark the point for 2/5 of a mile.
Compare the two marked positions and identify the fraction that represents the shorter distance.
Use the comparison selector to choose who lives closer to the school.
